explanation: range(len(items) + 1) lets the loop counter reach len(items), so on the final pass items[len(items)] is accessed — one past the last valid index, raising IndexError. The correct bound is range(len(items)), which visits exactly 0..len(items)-1.
prompt: What's the bug in this function that prints every element?
choices: The loop runs up to len(items), so items[len(items)] raises IndexError on the final pass
